summary: This Form 8-K reports an asset-backed securities issuance. American Honda Receivables LLC and American Honda Finance Corporation entered into an underwriting agreement with BofA Securities, BNP Paribas, Citigroup, and U.S. Bancorp for the sale of $2.105 billion in auto loan asset-backed notes from Honda Auto Receivables 2026-3 Owner Trust. The notes, with coupons from 3.964% to 4.62% plus a SOFR-linked tranche, will close on August 12, 2026. AHFC retains at least 5% of each class. This is a routine securitization, not a special situation; no corporate event triggers a category.
